trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one needs no separate effort: it fires the moment the other 54 trophies are all yours. In practice the last one to land is A Long Road, the 100% completion gold, so chase that and the Platinum arrives with it. Work the plan in order — story, then the 100% list in free roam, then the leftover strands — and this is the reward at the end.
trophies.tip: Watch A Long Road, not this trophy: the day that one pops, the Platinum pops with it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1, wraps up — just play the opening through to its end and it is yours.
trophies.tip: Use this first mission to learn the movement and shooting basics; everything here returns later.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks at the end of Chapter 1, once the last mission of the chapter is done. Before you cross into Chapter 2, though, handle the one thing in this chapter that can be missed: Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.tip: Finish the chapter's missions, but do Lucia's meditation first — it is the only missable step in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when Chapter 2 closes. Keep following the main missions and it arrives on its own at the chapter's end.
trophies.tip: Chapter 2 widens the map — start scanning unfamiliar vehicles with WAiNK as you travel.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when Chapter 3 closes. Keep following the main missions and it arrives at the chapter's end.
trophies.tip: Vice City itself opens up here — memorise where the shops and activity spots sit for later.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when Chapter 4 closes. While you are in this chapter, the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… appears — take it when it shows up, since it opens the bank vault jobs that take a while to finish.
trophies.tip: Start the vault jobs as soon as that optional mission appears; they stretch over several sessions.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss, and one of only two golds. It unlocks when the final story mission of Chapter 5 ends and the credits roll. After it, free roam opens with the whole map available and the 100% cleanup begins.
trophies.tip: Once the credits roll, the 100% grind starts — open the completion checklist before doing anything else.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks at the end of the mission Breakfast Run. Stay on the main mission path and it pops when the mission does.
trophies.tip: Breakfast Run comes early — no preparation needed, just follow the markers.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks at the end of the mission The Cartel Heist. Stay on the main mission path and it pops when the mission does.
trophies.tip: The game hands you what you need for this heist — your own loadout does not matter.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks at the end of the mission Child's Play. Stay on the main mission path and it pops when the mission does.
trophies.tip: Child's Play sits mid-campaign — watch for side missions opening around the same time.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks at the end of the mission Headliners. Stay on the main mission path and it pops when the mission does.
trophies.tip: Headliners is a big set piece — the trophy lands at the end however you play it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks at the end of the mission VCIA Takedown. Stay on the main mission path and it pops when the mission does.
trophies.tip: VCIA Takedown shows you the airport layout — you will be back here for Catch Me If You Can.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks at the end of the mission Operation Savage Glory. Stay on the main mission path and it pops when the mission does.
trophies.tip: This one lands late in the story — by now your weapons should handle any firefight.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game and the real gate to the Platinum. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — work from the story already counts toward it. The list is forgiving, roughly 60% of true completion rather than everything: 100 optional tasks, 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults, $250,000 of Marked Bills fenced, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied, all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, all 42 Drone Time Trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. None of it can be missed — it is all doable in free roam after the story — but expect it to take most of the roughly 200-hour Platinum run.
trophies.tip: Open the 100% checklist the moment the story ends and work it from the top — the menu order makes a decent route.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 different stunts across Leonida — jumps, flips and the rest, each distinct stunt counted once. They build up naturally when you drive fast over ramps and jumps; to hunt them on purpose, work the highways and the stunt jumps around Vice City. The 100% list asks for 300 of 397 stunts, so do not stop at 250 — the next 50 count toward A Long Road.
trophies.tip: Highway on-ramps and the big Vice City jumps are the most reliable spots — retry a jump until it registers.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, pool, mini golf, basketball, drone races and the other map activities. The map marks activity icons — one round of each is all it takes. Do it early, since the same activities return in bigger numbers on the 100% checklist.
trophies.tip: Do the activities you like least first and get them out of the way.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Find the ranges around Leonida and work through every challenge; gold takes quick, accurate shooting, so pick a weapon you trust and replay challenges as often as you like — retries cost nothing. All 42 are also on the 100% checklist, so this counts twice toward the Platinum.
trophies.tip: An upgraded rifle helps more than a fast trigger finger — accuracy is what earns gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations. The races run at Top Fun venues across the map — win once at every venue. The 100% list also wants all 42 Drone Time Trials finished, so run a venue's time trials while you are already there.
trophies.tip: Win the race first, then run the time trials at the same venue before you leave.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. A repeat win on the same race does not count again, so spread your wins across 20 separate race events. Races are marked on the map — mix street, off-road and water. The 100% list wants 30 of 40 unique races won, so keep racing past 20.
trophies.tip: Water races are often the easiest wins — start there if street races feel tough.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal at a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, take his challenge, then out-fish him — more fish, or bigger ones, inside the challenge. Fishing spots are marked on the map; steady reeling wins this one, not speed.
trophies.tip: Fish in daylight for the best visibility — Cal's challenge rewards patience, not speed.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Find a cabinet — arcades and some bars around Vice City have them — and play a full game through; any title works. The 100% list later asks you to play all four video games, so remember which ones you have already tried.
trophies.tip: Any cabinet counts — the arcade in the mall is usually the easiest to reach.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is a side-character storyline that opens during the campaign; play his missions in order and the trophy pops at the end of his last one. Side-character finales cannot be missed as long as you finish their strands — during the story, or in free roam afterwards.
trophies.tip: Andy's missions unlock gradually — check your phone for his calls between story missions.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Play through Kenton's strand in order and the trophy pops at his final mission. His strand connects to the treasure sets — 5 of 7 are needed for 100% — so collect as you go.
trophies.tip: Kenton's strand ties into treasure sets — pick up cards and sets while you work his missions.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Play through Billy's strand in order; the trophy pops at his final mission.
trophies.tip: Billy's missions are scattered across the map — do them when you are already in the area.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight Stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions show as pink-lettered icons on the map; each strand is a short chain of missions for one stranger. Any eight will do — more than eight exist, so skip the ones you do not like. The progress menu's Strangers & Freaks section tracks them.
trophies.tip: Pick the eight strands closest to where you already are — there is no reward for doing more than eight.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Play through Randy's strand in order; the trophy pops at his final mission.
trophies.tip: Randy's strand opens mid-game — finish it before the final missions so nothing is left hanging.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Play through Tyrone's strand in order; the trophy pops at his final mission.
trophies.tip: Tyrone's final mission is in Vice City — pair it with a shopping trip for Treat Yo Self.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Work through all 18 meditation spots in Leonida, spread across 10 locations — and mind the first one, because this is the only trophy in the game you can miss. In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, Lucia meditates on the balcony of Jason's house: find her in the kitchen in the morning, follow her out when she brings it up, and pick Accept. Once Chapter 1 is over that spot is gone, and no guide has confirmed whether the trophy can still be finished without it — so do it early and make a manual save straight after. The rest are marked meditation spots you can visit with either character; a spot meditated at by both Jason and Lucia counts twice toward the 18, and the last spot needs both of them playable together, which unlocks after Chapter 2. Note the 100% list only asks for 15 of 18, so this trophy needs three more than A Long Road does.
trophies.tip: Save manually the moment Lucia accepts the balcony meditation — if anything goes wrong you can reload Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take down a unique animal on one of Bret's hunts. His strand sends you after particular animals around Leonida, and finishing a single hunt pops the trophy. Keep going afterwards, though: all 15 of his Target Decks are on the 100% list.
trophies.tip: Study animals with binoculars first so you know where your target roams.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three whole Collectible Card sets. Cards hide all over Leonida — shops, streets, out-of-the-way corners — and a set counts once you hold every card in it. Three done pops the trophy, but the 100% list wants 15 of 18 sets, so treat this as the start of a long hunt and note card spots in WAiNK as you find them.
trophies.tip: Check every shop you walk into for cards — the count climbs faster than you would think.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Record 100 locations with the WAiNK app. Whenever the prompt appears, scan unfamiliar vehicles, landmarks and places — the app logs each one. Start during the story and scan as you travel: 100 scans is a 100% requirement too, and catching them on the move saves hours of going back later.
trophies.tip: Scan every new vehicle the moment you see it — backtracking for missed models is the slowest part.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. These are short objectives scattered across the map and the activities — driving, combat, stunts, exploration — and most of them finish by themselves as you play. The Challenges menu shows which are nearly done. The 100% list wants 70 of 80, so push past 50 and leave the ten toughest alone.
trophies.tip: Glance at the Challenges menu now and then and chase the ones closest to done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a four-star wanted level, then lose it and get clear. Break line of sight and stay out of view until the stars drop — alleys, the subway and open water all break the search. A quiet stretch of map, away from heavy police spawns, makes it much easier.
trophies.tip: A quiet highway at night is the best place to shake a four-star wanted level.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Hold up three shops in a row with your partner, without the wanted level dropping in between. Keep your partner close, hit the first shop, then the second and third straight away while the heat is still up. Choose three shops on the same street and plan the getaway before you start the first one.
trophies.tip: Three shops on one block make this easy — scout the street first.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Find 100 different vehicles. Drive them or scan them — WAiNK logs each new model as you meet it. Swap cars often during the story instead of sticking to one favourite; the 100% list wants 200 of 277 base models, so this is the first half of a longer count.
trophies.tip: Every car you drive counts — change vehicles often during the story.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Turn it on in a firefight with at least five enemies in sight and take five of them down before it runs out. Save it for a crowded shootout — a gang operation or a police chase — when the enemies are bunched together.
trophies.tip: Wait for five enemies grouped together — a gang hideout raid is ideal.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA on a plane that was never scheduled to take you. At Vice City International Airport, board a passenger jet as it taxis toward takeoff and get it airborne. Security is heavy, so arrive ready and move fast once you are on the runway.
trophies.tip: Board the plane while it taxis, not at the gate — the gate is guarded and the plane leaves without you.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank and put its cannon to work. Rhinos appear at military sites and during high wanted levels — take one, then use the cannon in a fight, on vehicles or enemies. Expect the military to come after you hard once you are inside.
trophies.tip: Steal the Rhino during a quiet moment — the response is heavy once the alarm sounds.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Clean out a jewelry store without anyone noticing. Case it first, slip in quietly, take the goods without tripping an alarm or being seen by staff or cameras — no witnesses, no alarm. A quiet hour helps, and the trick is getting out before anyone realises.
trophies.tip: Go at night when the store is empty — fewer staff means fewer witnesses.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Crack five bank vaults and get away clean, five times over. These are the big jobs — break the vault, grab the cash, lose the pursuit. The 100% list wants all eight vaults, so keep at it for the last three; the vault jobs open up through the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…
trophies.tip: Do one vault, then lay low and lose the heat before the next — rushing all five invites a wipe.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and get away. Find one on the road, stop it by ramming or blocking it, crack it open, take the cash, then lose the police. Trucks run highways and bank routes — pick one far from a police station and the getaway is far easier.
trophies.tip: Highways away from police stations are the best ambush spots.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover every region of Leonida. Drive, fly or sail through each area until no fog is left on the map. It mostly happens on its own while you chase the other trophies, but check for fogged corners — the islands and the far north — and sweep them deliberately.
trophies.tip: Fly over the map in a plane to reveal fogged regions fast.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit an Illegal Operation run by each of the nine gangs. Every gang has operations marked on the map — rob at least one for each gang. Work through them during the story; the 100% list wants all 39 operations anyway.
trophies.tip: Hit one operation per gang as you meet them — the 100% list wants all 39.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. The exact trigger is still being pinned down by the guide sites — if the first bar does not pop it, try other beachfront bars at different times of day and watch the linked sources for updates.
trophies.tip: Try the beachfront bars in the evening first — the trigger seems tied to the time of day.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through a vehicle showroom and out the other side, in classic style. Which showroom and the exact approach are still being confirmed by the guide sites — check the linked sources for the verified method once it is pinned down.
trophies.tip: A fast car and a straight run at the window work best — line up before you accelerate.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, steal the three key valuables and get out. Case the alley first, grab all three items, and leave before security locks the place down.
trophies.tip: Grab all three valuables before the alarm — the escape is the hard part, not the theft.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The current reading of this one ties it to maxing the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia — gym workouts, melee and heavy lifting all raise it. The description is vague on purpose and the method is still being confirmed, so if it does not pop, check the linked sources for the latest word.
trophies.tip: Train Strength a little after every mission — it adds up without a dedicated grind.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Rack up 500 actions on your Criminal Profile. The profile counts everything shady — robberies, thefts, getaways and the like — so play the way the game wants you to and the counter climbs on its own. It is a volume trophy that should land during the 100% grind with no special effort.
trophies.tip: Play naturally and it lands during the 100% grind — no need to farm criminal acts.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A story trophy with a deliberately vague description, and the guide sites have not confirmed the trigger yet. The wording hints at a second attempt working out, so it likely pops at a story moment — play the campaign through and it should land on its own. Watch the linked sources for the confirmed trigger once the guides pin it down.
trophies.tip: Keep the linked sources bookmarked — this one will be confirmed by the community first.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Another deliberately vague story trophy with no confirmed trigger yet. The title points at an unusual encounter somewhere in Leonida — play the story, poke around odd corners of the map, and check the linked sources once the guides confirm how it pops.
trophies.tip: Explore odd corners of the map between missions — the trigger is likely somewhere unusual.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — a bat or similar weapon swung from a moving vehicle, not a gun. The precise setup is still being confirmed by the guide sites; check the linked sources for the exact method once it is verified.
trophies.tip: A slow drive-by with a bat works better than a fast one — you need time to aim the swing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Move $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — hand them to a laundering contact and keep going until a quarter of a million has passed through. This is a 100% requirement as well, so the laundering you do for the checklist counts here too.
trophies.tip: Launder bills as you earn them — the total climbs steadily without a dedicated grind.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops of any kind. Clothes, weapons, food, car mods — everything counts toward the total. Most of it goes on its own on gear and vehicles; if you are short near the end, finish it off with pricey clothing or weapon attachments.
trophies.tip: Save expensive purchases for the end — you will need the cash for garages first.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the map — eight in total. They are marked as properties for sale, and you will need serious cash, so leave this until after the big story payouts and the vault jobs.
trophies.tip: Buy garages as the cash comes in — eight garages is a lot of money to save up at once.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Put 10 vehicles on the Scooter Bros app. Open the app and register cars you own or find — ten registrations pops the trophy. Register cars as you get them during the story and it finishes itself.
trophies.tip: Register every car you drive — ten registrations happen naturally if you do it as you go.
